verdict.rationale: CSC documents some event-driven automation. SOP documents are delivered according to customer-set routing preferences and designated contacts. The Corporate Tracker and Compliance Calendar automatically send email alerts and create events when good standing, name, or filing deadlines change. AI performs automated entity and folder routing of documents. However, these are mostly vendor-defined triggers with configurable recipients, not a general rule builder. Missing for 10: user-authored if-event-then-action rules, a choice of action types beyond email and routing, programmatic or webhook triggers, and independent corroboration.
